venture.name: Real Product
venture.audience: English-speaking solo consultants, coaches and boutique agency owners
venture.promise: A practical path to reducing repetitive admin and marketing work with controlled AI automation.
venture.sourceRights: Purchased source content; adapt and reframe. Do not transfer resale rights or distribute as a raw library.

artifacts.title: Time-Back Starter Kit — validation offer
artifacts.content:
Audience: English-speaking solo consultants, coaches and boutique agency owners
Offer: Time-Back Starter Kit (€19)
Promise: A practical path to reducing repetitive admin and marketing work with controlled AI automation.
Validation: organic demand before domain purchase or paid ads.

artifacts.title: Sales page outline
artifacts.content:
Headline: Get your week back—one workflow at a time.
Sections: problem diagnostic; Audit → Automate → Protect; what is included; honest limitations; test checkout.
Claims rule: no guaranteed time, revenue or ROI claims.

artifacts.title: Autonomous funnel map
artifacts.content:
LinkedIn diagnostic content → free AI Time-Leak Diagnostic → result-specific email → €19 Starter Kit → €79 core offer.
Tracking: visit, diagnostic complete, opt-in, checkout start, purchase and first-action completion.
Deployment: prepared in mock mode; public publishing remains gated.

artifacts.title: Five-email nurture sequence
artifacts.content:
1. Deliver the diagnostic result.
2. One practical audit win.
3. How to choose the first workflow.
4. Why tools alone do not save time.
5. Invite the reader to the €19 Starter Kit.
Status: drafted, not sent.

artifacts.title: Paid validation draft
artifacts.content:
Objective: diagnostic completions.
Budget proposal: €10/day for seven days.
Concepts: “Where does your week leak?” and “Audit → Automate → Protect.”
Activation: blocked until organic validation and explicit budget approval.

artifacts.title: Private launch visual brief
artifacts.content: Create one square editorial visual for Real Product. Show a calm solo business owner moving through three clearly separated stages: Audit, Automate, Protect. Warm ivory background, obsidian typography, one restrained copper accent, generous whitespace, premium editorial feel. No logos, testimonials, public figures, income claims, time-saving guarantees, or misleading product screenshots. The output is a private draft, not a final or published asset.

artifacts.title: Recurring operations plan
artifacts.content:
Daily: capture funnel health and exceptions.
Weekly: summarize traffic, opt-ins, sales, refunds and objections; propose one experiment.
Monthly: review offer economics, content themes and connector spend.
Escalate only: claim changes, spend increases, public activation, payment failures and customer complaints.
